verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. The record rests on two announcements: the Cabinet of Ministers portal's news item of 7 October 2023 on the roadmap's presentation (kmu.gov.ua; the item's text is the same in the copies of 11 and 17 Oct 2026, only the page around it changed) and the Ministry of Digital Transformation's news item on the planned AI law (thedigital.gov.ua, stored 11 Oct 2026; the page's metadata dates it 15 June 2026, a date its text does not show). They confirm the title, the date of presentation, the ministry as author, the expert committee, the bottom-up tools and the later instruments, as announcements do (level B). The roadmap itself is linked from the Cabinet item only through a URL shortener (cutt.ly) that leads to a PDF on cms.thedigital.gov.ua; the archiver could not store it on 17 or 18 Oct 2026 (the download timed out both times). No English version of the roadmap was found.
